turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so we have twenty minutes, and Owen found out about his zero from his phone in the middle of a class. Who decided that, and why did nobody call me first?
We're not, Hale; it's quarter past four and I'm not leaving until the zero comes off. Who decided it, and was Owen heard before it went in?
Just say okay and I'll write it up as resolved. Okay?
No. Nothing is resolved until the zero is withdrawn and you show me what it was based on.
I've answered that, Hale. No. What else do you have, or am I going to the principal's office?
Ms. Kalinowski. I need you to say okay.
You need a lot of things, Hale, and so does Owen. If the next thing out of your mouth isn't a reason for that zero, I'm walking down the hall to the principal.
